title: SC01-T1 — the carts hit (SH01, SH02, SH03, SH04a, SH04b, SH05, SH06, SH07)
line: Michelle? Is that you? My God, what happened, / did you get work done? You look so much more beautiful. / It is just me.
motionPlan: Michelle pushes her cart briskly up the aisle toward the walkway, the camera backing away in front of her; Peter's cart swings round the end-cap into her path → the two carts collide nose to nose with a jolt, both carts rocking back; both pairs of hands lurch on the handles → Peter looks up annoyed, then his face changes completely — eyes widening, scanning her head to toe; behind him the woman stiffens → Peter, staring, says it in one breath, his hand loose on the cart handle → Peter, staring, says it in one breath, his hand loose on the cart handle → Michelle holds his look for a beat, calm, cool, unbothered, and says it with one corner of her mouth lifting → Michelle steers her cart around his and walks off along the walkway, unhurried, the camera following behind her → Peter stands frozen staring after her; the woman beside him turns from Michelle to Peter, stiffening
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
